processing: Detected the varying opaque magenta key in a browser canvas and converted keyed pixels to alpha with soft edge decontamination.
Split the source at its exact horizontal and vertical midpoint into ready, thinking, encouraging, and celebration cells.
Computed each alpha bounding box, added 30 source-pixel padding, and square-cropped without clipping accents.
Encoded each transparent crop as 512x512 WebP using cwebp -q 84 -alpha_q 100 -m 6.
intermediate_note: Intermediate transparent PNG crops were intentionally omitted from version control because they are deterministic derivatives and add about 1.1 MB; the untouched provider source, prompt, truthful metadata, processing recipe, hashes, and optimized production assets are retained.
